title: MCP clients get an OAuth flow
summary:
MCP authentication gained an OAuth flow, Grok-3 Mini joined the model list, and the community directory got a little less messy.

MCP authentication moved from session polling to OAuth 2.1, with authorization-code and refresh-token exchange plus dynamic client registration. Azure GPT Image editing also now fetches string image inputs as URLs rather than accepting data URIs or local paths.

Added `grok` for Azure-hosted Grok-3 Mini with tool support, and changed `openai-large` to route to GPT-4.1 instead of GPT-4.1 Mini. The auth UI also labels its referrer and domain controls more clearly.

The project directory now describes Mirexa AI Chat’s capabilities under its updated name, without a duplicate entry. It also lists AdvanceChatGptBot, a Telegram bot that uses Pollinations through gpt4free.

daily.title: OAuth for MCP clients
daily.text: MCP clients can authenticate through an OAuth 2.1 authorization flow with refresh tokens and dynamic client registration. [Read the MCP docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs#tag/mcp-servers).

daily.title: Grok-3 Mini added
daily.text: Use `grok` for Azure-hosted Grok-3 Mini text generation with tool support. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=grok).

daily.title: Larger openai-large model
daily.text: `openai-large` now routes to GPT-4.1 instead of GPT-4.1 Mini. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=openai-large).
